title: Cartier local annihilation of nilpotents at rational points
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic zero [def-weil-field]. A commutative Hopf $k$-algebra here means a unital commutative $k$-algebra $A$ with $k$-algebra maps $\Delta_A:A\to A\otimes_k A$, $\epsilon_A:A\to k$, $S_A:A\to A$ such that $(\Delta_A\otimes1)\Delta_A=(1\otimes\Delta_A)\Delta_A$, $(\epsilon_A\otimes1)\Delta_A=(1\otimes\epsilon_A)\Delta_A=1_A$, and $\mu_A(S_A\otimes1)\Delta_A=\mu_A(1\otimes S_A)\Delta_A=\eta_A\epsilon_A$, under the usual tensor unit and associativity identifications; $\mu_A$ and $\eta_A$ are multiplication and unit. Tensor products are those of [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property]. Suppose $A$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For every $k$-algebra homomorphism $g:A\to k$ and every $b\in A$ with $b^n=0$ for some $n\geq1$, there exists $t\in A$ such that $g(t)=1$ and $tb=0$.
